newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Premier says industrial layoffs limited.
newsitem.headline: Thai Premier says industrial layoffs limited.

text.p: Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh on Monday played down estimates of worker layoffs in Thailand's sluggish industrial sector.

"The number of workers facing layoff is only about 20,000," Chavalit told reporters. "The government can deal with this problem because labour ministry reports show that 90,000 job vacancies are still available."

Labour leaders and industry analysts said at the weekend that at least 40,000 workers, mostly those in the textile industry, could lose their jobs this year as Thailand's export slump showed no signs of a speedy recovery.

"At least 40,000 labour workers face layoffs and this is a product of government mishandling of economic problems," Lae Dilockwilas of Chulalongkorn University told a gathering of 300 labour union representatives and analysts.
